risk_note: RV2 (orders/**, linking/**, app.module.ts; no money). Pending-track cards: GET /v1/orders/pending-tracks picks one open attempt per platform (reported jumps first, latest open), completion judged per attempt (attr_at not earlier than open time minus the tolerance, default 120 s), 72-hour expiry; POST dismiss writes link_open_attempts.dismissed_at idempotently, own attempts only. Linking tables only through linking's exported port; identity from the access token only. No order, rebate_status or hold writes. listPendingTracks / dismissPendingTrack lose x-implementation: planned (mechanical, regenerated). Five documented defaults (D10-53).
